decision.explanation: The question asks for the director of the film 'The Charge of the Light Brigade' without specifying a year. The source documents describe three distinct films with this title: the 1912 film directed by J. Searle Dawley (D1S1), the 1936 film directed by Michael Curtiz (D4S2), and the 1968 film directed by Tony Richardson (D2S2). While some documents contain erroneous claims attributing the 1912 film to Steven Spielberg (D2S1, D3S2), these are contradicted by the specific 1912 film descriptions in D1S1 and D7S1 which correctly identify J. Searle Dawley. As multiple distinct films share the name and have different directors, all three valid directors are included as complementary answers.
